lines.1: 「Date, you are to report to the director's office during lunch.」
lines.4: 「Whoa, what did you do, Subaru? Get in another fight?」
lines.5: 「No idea. Sure, I've punched plenty of guys I didn't like, but...」
lines.6: 「Hey, you don't think they found out about that, do you?」
lines.9: 「Well, I'm off to the faculty room.」
lines.10: 「Could it be that huge scene you caused when you helped Yashi?」
lines.11: 「Would anyone really snitch over a little thing like that...? Well, I'll find out when I get there.」
lines.14: 「We'll watch over him from a distance. You're worried, aren't you?」
lines.15: 「If there's trouble, I'll help however I can. Going now would just be rubbernecking, so count me out.」
lines.17: They really had nothing better to do.
lines.18: I was on my own for lunch...
